# Device frame

The iPhone 14 Pro frame rules are from [Devices.css](https://github.com/picturepan2/devices.css) by Yan Zhu / picturepan2, v0.2.0, retrieved on 2026-10-26 from `dist/devices.css`.

Only the shared device rules and iPhone 14 Pro variants are included. Their declarations are unchanged. The MIT license is included in `LICENSE` and in a preserved CSS license comment. `src/digital.css` integrates the screen contents and responsive scaling.
